purpose: Document separate English/local-language discovery, first-party registry custody, anonymous request outcomes, safe-field limits, and geometry uncertainty.
assessment: A first-party Ebonyi State Ministry of Lands and Survey / Office of the Surveyor-General land-registration and survey custodian is evidenced for Abakaliki. The reviewed official material documents C-of-O and registration procedures and references digitization/GIS work, but no public parcel geometry service was verified.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is limited to evidenced local/state custody and procedure scope. It is not a claim that a public cadastral layer exists or that the city is fully covered.
